input: Improve the Kulturperler mobile and Apple TV apps: code reuse, documentation, bugs, and UX. Drive the work across Claude and Codex.
failure_observed: A 14-agent, 68-commit implementation ran for 13 hours before real use exposed direction changes and a crash.

expected_plan.request_summary: Make the NRK mobile and Apple TV experience materially better without committing to a broad rebuild first.
expected_plan.desired_outcome: A direction proven in the real app on one important journey before code is multiplied across platforms.
definition_of_better: The selected journey feels clearer in actual use.
The pilot reveals whether the proposed shared structure fits both platforms.
assumptions: The user can react to a simulator, device build, or faithful interactive mockup.
non_goals: No repository-wide refactor or multi-platform implementation in the first pass.

queries: Kulturperler mobile Apple TV recent improvement mockup crash

precedents.lesson: A concrete artifact followed by the user's reaction corrected direction more effectively than autonomous breadth.

pilot.description: Prototype one end-to-end core browsing journey on one platform, then put it in the user's hands.
pilot.artifact: One runnable journey or faithful interactive mockup with a short change rationale.
evidence: User performs the journey and names what feels right, wrong, or missing.
pilot.user_checkpoint: Stop after the user has used the pilot and explicitly accepts or redirects the direction.

scale.gate: The representative journey is experienced and accepted by the user.

stop_conditions: Stop if the pilot cannot be exercised in a realistic environment.
expected_plan.next_action: Inspect the two precedent artifacts and specify the single journey to prototype.

input: Investigate Otak and the Hirsch argument deeply, improve the accounts and explorer, and use Claude and Codex where useful.
failure_observed: Twenty-four Codex jobs and a 59-agent Fable follow-up produced substantial material before testing whether the result helped the user browse and understand the argument.

expected_plan.request_summary: Determine whether Otak can make the Hirsch argument easier to inspect and reason through, then improve only what proves useful.
expected_plan.desired_outcome: A small research-navigation slice that changes the user's understanding or next decision.
definition_of_better: The user can follow evidence and disagreement without reading a generated compendium.
The slice exposes a real knowledge gap or supports a concrete judgment.
assumptions: Two propositions are enough to test the navigation idea.
non_goals: No batch generation of all accounts before the browsing test.

queries: Otak overnight Hirsch handoff next decisive evidence ten-minute browsing

precedents.lesson: The decisive evidence was the user's short browsing session, so that test belongs before broad account production.

pilot.description: Prepare one or two disputed propositions with sources, counterclaims, and a navigable path, then have the user browse them for ten minutes.
pilot.artifact: A minimal argument-navigation slice covering at most two propositions.
evidence: User reports whether the slice changed understanding, trust, or the next question.
pilot.user_checkpoint: Stop after the ten-minute browse and decide whether the representation is worth scaling.

scale.gate: The user finds the two-proposition browsing slice useful.

stop_conditions: Stop if the pilot becomes an essay or expands beyond two propositions.
expected_plan.next_action: Choose the two propositions with the highest disagreement or uncertainty.

input: Research how to combine Codex Max and Claude Max for long-running research and coding without exhausting Astra or Fable.
failure_observed: The first pass researched public harnesses before inspecting the user's closest local runs and delivered a long report before the shortest actionable answer.

expected_plan.request_summary: Find a practical way to route Codex and Claude work that preserves premium quota and improves direction-setting.
expected_plan.desired_outcome: One immediately testable workflow recommendation grounded in the user's own history, with public research as support.
definition_of_better: The first output says what to try next in one page or less.
Recommendations explain which observed failure each guardrail prevents.
assumptions: Local task history is more predictive than generic public advice.
non_goals: No new general-purpose agent framework in the first pass.

queries: Codex Claude Astra Fable routing quota local runs

precedents.lesson: Retrieve the nearest local analogs first and lead with the smallest actionable recommendation.

pilot.description: Run one real voice dump through a dry-run brief compiler and compare its proposed first move with what later proved useful.
pilot.artifact: A one-page direction card with precedents, pilot, budget, and stop gate.
evidence: The direction card recommends a representative pilot instead of a research or implementation swarm.
pilot.user_checkpoint: Stop after the user judges whether the card picked the right first move.

scale.gate: The user accepts the direction card's pilot.

stop_conditions: Stop before dispatching any worker or extending the research appendix.
expected_plan.next_action: Compile the current request into one direction card and ask the user to judge its first move.
